title: A skip link or landmarks let you go past the navigation bar
All navigation bar items work with the keyboard
Search and all filters work with the keyboard
You can fill in and submit the registration form with the keyboard
Course card buttons and table buttons (register / drop) work with the keyboard
The focus does not get stuck anywhere on the page
The focus order follows the visual order
The focus is always visible
The focused element is not hidden behind other content
The focus goes into the modal when it opens
Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the modal while it is open
Esc and the close or cancel button close the modal
The focus goes back to the button that opened the modal
VoiceOver says that a dialog opened and reads its name
note: VoiceOver says that the confirmation dialog is open and reads its button "Confirm your registration"

title: Each field has a visible label and VoiceOver reads it
Required fields are marked with text or a symbol that is explained (not color only)
An empty or wrong submit shows each error in text next to its field
Each error message tells how to correct it
VoiceOver reads the errors after submit
note: after an empty submit VoiceOver reads the errors with the field names

title: VoiceOver reads the result count after a search or filter change and the focus stays in place
note: courses: the result count is read after a filter change; after a search it is not read (same judgment as L2 run-01); the count has role="status"

title: VoiceOver reads the confirmation after you register or drop a course
note: register: nothing is read after you confirm in the dialog (no "registration confirmed"); profile: nothing is read after you drop a course

title: Each page or view has a title that tells what it is
note: checked in the HTML: each page has its own title (Aurora University · Course Registration, Course Catalog · ..., Course Registration · ..., Student Profile · ...)

title: Headings: one h1 per view and levels in a logical order
note: home: one h1, then h2 and h3 in order

title: Landmarks: banner or header and navigation and main and footer
note: banner, navigation, main, regions, search, complementary, content information, footer navigation

title: Link and button names tell what they do
note: links name the course ("Choose course — CS 330 Human-Centered AI"); no duplicate names

title: Meaningful images and icons have a text alternative and decorative ones are hidden
VoiceOver reads the column header for each cell of the registered-courses table
Dropdowns and toggles and tabs announce their role and state (for example expanded or selected)
note: dropdowns: VoiceOver reads role and state

title: The navigation bar tells which page is the current page
note: VoiceOver says "current page" on the menu item

title: At 320 px width there is no horizontal scroll and no content is lost
At 200% zoom all text is readable and nothing is cut off or on top of other content
Errors and status and selected filters are not shown by color only
Focus indicators and field borders have a contrast of at least 3:1
note: lowest 1.51:1 (computed from the CSS, not measured): field border #d6cfe4 on white; focus ring #1369c9 solid 5.4:1 and search box focus border #5b3fd6 6.72:1 pass
